scripts.clean: rimraf docs/bundle.js docs/bundle.css docs/lib.js docs/index.html docs/material.min.js.map docs/material.min.css.map
scripts.prep: concat node_modules/material-design-lite/material.min.js node_modules/d3/d3.min.js node_modules/seedrandom/seedrandom.min.js > docs/lib.js && copyfiles -u 2 node_modules/material-design-lite/material.min.js.map docs
scripts.build-js: browserify src/playground.ts -p [tsify] -o docs/bundle.js && uglifyjs docs/bundle.js -c -o docs/bundle.js
scripts.build: npm run prep && npm run build-js && npm run build-css && npm run build-html
scripts.watch: npm run prep && concurrently "npm run watch-js" "npm run watch-css" "npm run watch-html"
